verdicts.explanation: data-nosnippet on this page wraps only decorative editor-UI mockup labels (e.g. 'Canvas', 'Dock', 'Layers'); the page's real primary content -- its h1 and its FAQ questions and answers -- carries no nosnippet attribute and is fully quotable.

Most of the 12 counted fields are aria-hidden anti-spam honeypots (aria-hidden="true", tabindex="-1") that assistive tech never reaches, and the 'message' field already carries aria-label="message". Only the visible required 'Prompt' textarea genuinely lacks a label, not 12 of 12 fields.
The homepage carousel's pagination control is a real, visible button with no text, aria-label, or title -- just three unlabelled dots -- so a screen reader user cannot tell what it does.
The page is the store's FAQ page (shipping, returns, sizing, payment methods), not a page for a single priced item, so it does not owe Product structured data the way a product detail page would.

site_specific: Add aria-label="Describe what you want to design" (or a visible label tied via for/id) to the required Prompt textarea in the homepage agent-input form.

Leave the anti-spam honeypot fields (website, company, subject, title, feedback, notes, details, remarks, comments) aria-hidden as they are -- they are not meant to be reachable, so they do not need labels.
Wrap the 11 pricing FAQ headings (starting with 'What are credits?') and each heading's following paragraph in FAQPage/Question/Answer JSON-LD.
Keep each answer self-contained in one paragraph so an assistant can lift the question and answer as a single unit.
